title: Advanced Honors Seminar; Science Diplomacy: Foreign Policy and Science, Technology, and Innovation
description: Cross-listed with FGSM370. Credit granted for FGSM370 or HONR378D. Students must be in the Global Fellows Program to register. An exploration of the critical roles scientific knowledge and technological innovation play in the formation and implementation of foreign policy issues, including energy and climate change, public health, space and innovation, and economic development.
